title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Missing-Items Excusal Points
content:
**Clause.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the missing-items excusal points are the missing-items excusal credit, capped at the points the disputed violation was recorded with. The missing-items excusal credit is the batch-size credit, used as it stands whatever the batch type, plus the feedback credit, less the repeat reduction, never below zero, where the batch-size credit, the feedback credit and the repeat reduction are each zero points.

**The disputed violation.** The violation is the one named on the missing-items dispute that stands submitted; its recorded points are the points on that violation entry.

## Order of calculation

1. The batch-size credit, as it stands, and the feedback credit are added.
2. The repeat reduction is subtracted once.
3. A negative figure counts as zero; this is the excusal credit.
4. The excusal credit is then capped at the recorded points of the disputed violation: the excusal points are the lower of the two.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Batch-size credit | 0 points, used as it stands whatever the batch type |
| Feedback credit | 0 points |
| Repeat reduction | 0 points |
| Excusal credit | 0 plus 0 less 0, that is 0 points |

## Worked example (hypothetical violation)

A disputed missing-items violation was recorded with 2 points. The excusal credit is 0 points plus 0 points less 0 points, that is 0 points; the lower of 0 points and the 2 recorded points is 0. The excusal points are 0.

The cap comes last: the floor at zero is applied to the credit first, and only then is the credit compared with the recorded points.
